title: SE implementation scratchpad - Mariner Credit Union
content:
Daily scratchpad - implementation runbook / notes (Mariner Credit Union)
Owner: Avery Chen (SE)
Context: Private deployment for Mariner CU POC. They need VPC-based Private control plane + optional on-prem model runtime for PII workflows. Primary asks: network isolation, KMS integration (AWS KMS), audit logs to their Splunk, and model pinning/rollout control.

Goals this week:
- Get base Private deployment up in Mariner dev VPC (non-prod)
- Verify KMS envelope keys + key rotation flow
- Confirm audit log delivery to Splunk via Kinesis Firehose
- Deploy model v1 (redwood-optimized-7b-qa) and run smoke tests
- Document config snippets for customer's infra team

Notes / quick plan:
1) Networking
   - Customer provides dev VPC peering info (VPC ID, account) + allowed CIDR for control plane egress
   - Need to confirm: do they want NAT gateway or VPC endpoints for S3? They prefer VPC endpoints where possible.
   - TODO: Ask infra (Luis) for exact route table updates required.
   - Quick checklist: create interface endpoints for SSM, EC2, KMS, S3 -> test S3 access from host in private subnet.

2) KMS / secrets
   - Using AWS KMS (customer-managed). We will create a symmetric CMK for Redwood service to encrypt model artifacts and cache keys.
   - Must add Redwood role ARN to key policy. Need customer's KMS key ARN.
   - Action: Sana to draft minimal IAM policy and key policy snippet.
   - Verify key rotation: enable automatic yearly rotation and run decryption test after rotation simulated.

3) Audit logs -> Splunk
   - Customer wants all control-plane audit logs + token-level request logs forwarded. Plan: put CloudWatch Logs -> Kinesis Firehose -> Splunk HEC.
   - Important: scrub PII before sending (token hashes only). Confirm PII redaction retained for evaluation traces.
   - TODO: get Splunk HEC endpoint + token from Mariner security team (JIRA: SE-4521 comment).

4) Model lifecycle / rollout
   - Pin initial model to redwood-optimized-7b-qa:v2026-02-15 for POC. Use canary rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100%.
   - Evaluation harness: run regen tests + semantic similarity checks on internal test set (50 prompts). Threshold: <=2% quality regression vs baseline.
   - Add fallback policy to smaller faster model (redwood-optimized-4b-ff) if latency SLO violated >10% over 5min.

5) Runtime config notes (commands + snippets)
   - Deploy runtime: ./rictl deploy --env mariner-dev --config configs/mariner/private-config.yaml
   - Example private-config highlights:
     - control_plane.endpoint: https://private-control.mariner.example.com
     - kms.key_arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcdef00-1111-2222-3333-444444444444
     - logging.forwarder: kinesis-firehose://fk-logs-mariner-dev
     - allowed_cidrs: [10.10.0.0/16]
   - Note: replace key_arn placeholder with customer-provided key.

6) Test plan / smoke tests
   - Network: from runtime instance, curl S3 private endpoint (signed URL) and confirm object read/write.
   - KMS: encrypt/decrypt small payload via AWS CLI using provided CMK.
   - Model: run 100 sample prompts through hosted endpoint and collect latency/accuracy stats. Protect sample prompts w/ customer NDA.
   - Logs: confirm delivery to Splunk and sample event shows request_id, model_version, token_count (no raw prompt).

Open questions / risks
- Customer still deciding on NAT vs endpoints -> affects egress costs and our support for outbound. Need final decision by 2026-03-05.
- KMS cross-account policies are sometimes sticky for their security team. If we hit delays, propose using temporary key and rotate later.
- On-prem runtime (if needed) has GPU procurement timeline unknown. For POC, recommend GPU-less inference using smaller model or trial on dedicated hosted capacity.

Action items (personal to-do)
- [ ] Draft IAM & KMS key policy snippet (Sana assigned) -> due 2026-02-24
- [ ] Request Splunk HEC endpoint & sample event schema (Avery) -> pinged 2026-02-21, follow up 2026-02-23
- [ ] Create private-config.yaml template and check into internal repo (Avery) -> in progress
- [ ] Setup dev stack in my account and run S3/KMS smoke tests (Avery) -> blocked until KMS ARN
- [ ] Schedule sync with Mariner infra (Luis + Avery) 30m this week -> propose 2026-02-25

Meeting notes (2026-02-21 sync with Mariner infra)
- They will provide KMS ARN and Splunk HEC by end of week.
- Prefer VPC endpoints; security will review key policy.
- Want 2-week POC: network + model v1 tests, then decide on on-prem pilot.

Quick scratch (commands I used)
- aws kms encrypt --key-id alias/mariner-se-key --plaintext fileb://sample.txt --output text --query CiphertextBlob | base64 --decode > ct.bin
- aws s3 ls --endpoint-url https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com
- ./rictl status --env mariner-dev --verbose

Notes to self:
- Keep customer in the loop on the fallback model decision (latency vs quality trade-offs).
- Keep the config template minimal; Mariner security will iterate and we should avoid heavy YAML churn in the first pass.

References / links:
- Confluence draft: Confluence:mariner-cu-private-deploy-setup (internal)
- JIRA: SE-4521 (audit logs / HEC)
- GH PR: private-deployments/pull/398 - initial template for private-config.yaml

End of scratchpad entry. Will update after Splunk endpoint or KMS ARN received.
